# Requirements Quality Checklist: Transcript History

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of feature 005 (FR-16 with NFR-06, FR-28 constraints) — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage of the spec before planning
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard · Audience: reviewer (spec/plan review) · Focus: privacy/data lifecycle and failure handling, history UI states. Items marked `[x]` were resolved by the generating agent by improving the spec in the same session (as the caller instructed); each says how. The owner/reviewer may re-open any of them.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the moment that defines an entry's "time" specified (recording start, final text ready, or paste)? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities] — resolved: "UTC instant the final text was ready".
- [x] CHK002 Is it specified whether an entry is created when the paste or the clipboard write fails after the final text was ready? [Gap, Spec §FR-001] — resolved: FR-001 records every non-empty final text that reaches delivery, whatever the paste outcome.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a failed "Copy" (clipboard unavailable)? [Gap, Exception Flow] — resolved: FR-018 and an edge case added.
- [x] CHK004 Are keyboard operability and accessible names required for the History window's actions? [Gap, Coverage] — resolved: FR-017 added.
- [x] CHK005 Is the behaviour defined when History is opened while its window is already open? [Gap, Spec §FR-005] — resolved: bring to front, no second window.
- [x] CHK006 Is the access-control expectation for unencrypted stored text stated? [Gap, Security] — resolved: Assumptions name default per-user `%LOCALAPPDATA%` permissions.
- [x] CHK007 Is the maximum data volume of stored history stated? [Gap, Data volume] — resolved: Assumptions (≤ 100 entries × ~15 000 chars, < ~2 MB).
- [ ] CHK008 Is a requirement for removing history on uninstall verifiable within this feature, or only via feature 006's installer tests? [Dependency, Spec §FR-016, req FR-28] — open: this feature can only guarantee location (FR-016); removal is verified by 006.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "preview" of an entry quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] — resolved: first 3 lines or 200 characters, whichever is shorter.
- [x] CHK010 Is the displayed time format specified (time only vs date and time, time zone)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005] — resolved: time for today, date+time otherwise, local time, UI-language format.
- [x] CHK011 Is the "Copied" confirmation's duration specified? [Clarity, Spec §US1-AS2] — resolved: 2 s.
- [x] CHK012 Is "engine" defined precisely enough to test (kind only vs kind + model)? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities] — resolved by clarification Q4 (confirmed by the owner 2026-10-02).
- [x] CHK013 Is "deleted" defined (file removal vs secure wipe)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007/FR-008] — resolved: file-system removal; secure wipe out of scope (Assumptions).
- [x] CHK014 Is it defined how long the "could not be saved / deleted" notice stays visible? [Clarity, Edge Cases] — resolved: until the next successful write or deletion.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Do FR-007 (no confirmation) and the req FR-16 acceptance example ("when Clear is clicked, then the list is empty") agree? [Consistency] — yes.
- [x] CHK016 Is the entry text consistent with what the user received when post-processing is skipped (FR-09)? [Consistency, Edge Cases] — yes: the delivered (raw) text.
- [x] CHK017 Is "Copy" consistent with FR-10's clipboard exclusion marks (r1#28)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006] — yes: same clipboard path.
- [x] CHK018 Is the combined change "lower N + turn off" in one save defined without conflict? [Conflict, Edge Cases] — resolved: turning off wins.
- [x] CHK019 Is the N range 1–100 consistent with what feature 004's settings form will offer and validate? [Consistency, Dependency, Spec §FR-003] — resolved: 004 FR-004/FR-005 define 1–100, default 20, in one place; 005 FR-003 now consumes 004's range instead of claiming to define it.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK020 Can "stored data is deleted" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — yes: 0 matches of any prior entry text in the data folder.
- [x] CHK021 Can "nothing more is written to disk" be verified? [Measurability, Spec §US3-AS2] — yes: no history file created in the data folder after dictations while off.
- [ ] CHK022 Can SC-005 ("under 1 second on the reference machine") be measured while the reference machine is undefined (OQ-03)? [Measurability, Assumption] — open: depends on OQ-03.
- [x] CHK023 Does every req FR-16 acceptance example (20 of 25 shown; Clear empties and deletes; off deletes and stops writing) map to an acceptance scenario? [Traceability] — yes: US1-AS1, US2-AS1, US3-AS1/AS2.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are recovery requirements defined for a deletion that fails (file locked)? [Recovery, Spec §FR-009] — yes: fallback to replacing the stored data, then retry at every later change, shown in the window; deletion at every start while off. Plan research showed a "retry at next start" for a failed Clear while on has nothing persisted to act on, so FR-009 now states that limit explicitly.
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a leftover history file found at start while history is off? [Recovery, Spec §US3-AS3] — yes.
- [x] CHK026 Are non-delivery outcomes (transcription failed, no speech, too short, Esc, retry success) covered for whether an entry is created? [Coverage, Edge Cases] — yes.
- [x] CHK027 Is history-on-again behaviour (old entries not restored) specified? [Alternate Flow, Spec §US3-AS4] — yes.
- [x] CHK028 Is live-update behaviour defined for turn-off and clear while the window is open? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005] — resolved: the window follows all history changes.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Are corrupt/unreadable stored history and unwritable storage addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010] — yes.
- [x] CHK030 Is crash consistency (never half-written) specified? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004] — yes.
- [x] CHK031 Are empty final texts and very long texts addressed? [Edge Case] — yes.
- [x] CHK032 Is ordering defined when the clock changes or results finish out of order? [Edge Case, req FR-23] — yes: insertion (delivery) order.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Is "transcript text never in logs" stated for history's own errors? [Security, Spec §FR-011, req FR-20] — yes.
- [x] CHK034 Is "no network" stated for history? [Privacy, Spec §FR-014, req NFR-05] — yes.
- [x] CHK035 Is the idle-resource constraint (no resident window) stated? [Performance, Spec §FR-015, req NFR-03] — yes.
- [x] CHK036 Are EN/RU texts required for every History state? [i18n, Spec §FR-013, req FR-15] — yes.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Are the dependencies on 001 (tray item, delivery point, clipboard writer) and 004 (settings fields, apply notification) and 006 (uninstall) documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions] — yes.
- [x] CHK038 Are the five clarifications (N range, trim timing, no-confirm Clear, engine = kind + model, off-state window) confirmed by the owner? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications] — open: awaiting owner.
